root_cause.claude: Build process. The evox16 focused precheck ran module goals including the legacy Telecom app; `m Telecom` installed system/priv-app/Telecom into the shared staging directory. The full incremental build never removed it (it is not in the product install list) and packed it into system.img next to TelecomShim. Both are com.android.server.telecom; PackageManager scanned Telecom first and skipped TelecomShim as a duplicate, so the mainline TelecomLoaderService got the legacy ITelecomLoader binder and system_server crashed on the first TelecomManager call.
root_cause.codex: Same mechanism, found independently (precheck installed legacy Telecom.apk; staging packaged both; PackageManager kept legacy Telecom).
